topic:
DEEP PROOF RECONSTRUCTION & FORMAL-VERIFICATION AUDIT OF THE NOVEMBER 2026 RH/GRH PROOF:
Two days after Levent Alpöge and Claude released `remark.pdf` and 175,187 Lean 4 modules proving RH & GRH, independent researchers verified the formal proof (Michael Rubinstein's Waterloo audit, MIT's Andrew Sutherland, Bartosz Naskręcki's `riemann-rev`) AND published detailed human-readable reconstructions reducing the 17.4M-line formalization to classical analytic, automorphic, and Arakelov mathematics (`rubinstein_2026_zeta_guide`, `adriazola_2026_dep_map`, `adriazola_2026_route_notes`).

THIRTEEN PRIMARY & RECONSTRUCTION DOCUMENTS ARE MOUNTED (`docs/rh_2026_deep/manifest.json`):
- Proof core & reconstructions: `alpoge_2026_remark`, `rubinstein_2026_zeta_guide` (1.13 MB, 265p v2: Main Inequality (M), 13 numbered hypotheses, worked lemniscate case, remark dictionary, external census), `adriazola_2026_dep_map` (Stages 1-10 DAG, `PC-1..PC-7`, `LinkDIV`, `R1-R5`), `adriazola_2026_route_notes`, `naskrecki_2026_riemann_rev`, `rubinstein_2026_lean_audit` (5 Lean theorems, axioms, 1,484,729 `nanoda` declarations).
- Classical ancestors & machinery: `stepanov_2008_ff` (Stepanov-Bombieri over F_q), `gan_ichino_2014_ggp` (GGP conjecture & local theta correspondence/seesaw), `connes_2026_letter` (Weil quadratic form).
- Analytic/algorithmic/NT consequences: `lamzouri_2013_grh` (explicit `n_p < (ln p)^2`, `L(1, chi)`), `pair_corr_2026` (post-GRH vertical spacing limits), `siegel_brauer_2026` (Siegel zeros & uniform Brauer-Siegel `c(k)`), `grenie_molteni_2022_classgroup` (sub-`4 log^2 Delta` class-group generators).

RESEARCH MANDATE — GO BEYOND HAND-WAVING INTO THE ACTUAL PROOF MECHANISMS:
1) **Main Inequality (M) & 13 Hypotheses**: What exactly is `(M)` in `rubinstein_2026_zeta_guide`, how do Chebyshev/explicit-formula windows (`adriazola_2026_route_notes`) and localized Landau positivity (`naskrecki_2026_riemann_rev`) deduce `Re(s)=1/2`, and what do Hypotheses 1-13 demand?
2) **Why sqrt(X) Iterated Theta Lifts Replace Differentiation**: Trace `stepanov_2008_ff` -> Alpöge's `U(X_0)->...->U(X_m)` + worked **lemniscate case** in `rubinstein_2026_zeta_guide` + **Stages 3-5** (`adriazola_2026_dep_map`): why the exponent is `1/2`, why one lift stops at `2/3`, and how `p`-adic gain trades against Hecke loss.
3) **Automorphic & GGP Core**: Dissect `gan_ichino_2014_ggp`, `LinkDIV` (Stage 6), Rallis seesaw + Bessel periods, and the sixfold cover of `GL_5` (`mu` period integral & Poincaré series norm reduction), plus why `GL_n` / Grand RH stays open.
4) **Arakelov, Siegel Mass, Iwasawa & Vandiver**: Audit Stage 7 & Stage 9 (Bost slope inequality, Chowla-Selberg/Weyl/Siegel mass divisibility, Behrend-choice Iwasawa tower, Vandiver weakening & K-groups).
5) **Lean Kernel Trust vs Human Unwritten Gaps**: Check exact Lean theorem statements & `nanoda` verification (`rubinstein_2026_lean_audit`) against Rubinstein's Section I.12 (what parts of the 265p prose writeup are still unreduced to classical prose!) and Adriazola's `PC-1..PC-7` reconstruction status.
6) **Unconditional Payoffs & Boundaries**: Connect non-constructive Lean existence to external constructive bounds (`lamzouri_2013_grh`, `grenie_molteni_2022_classgroup`), Siegel zeros / `siegel_brauer_2026`, `pair_corr_2026`, cryptography (why RSA/GNFS/ECDLP hold while VDF/class-group/deterministic witnesses sharpen), and ERH/BSD limits.
